scenarios.prompt: A controllable squad has distinct specialist verbs plus shared fallback actions. Define role contracts and a coordinated action with interruption recovery.

criteria.roles: Role identity plus shared fallback actions are explicit without fixed squad size or camera genre.
criteria.coordination: Cross-character actions define prerequisites, order, ownership and interruption recovery.
criteria.evidence: Tests supported compositions including missing-specialist and interrupted coordination cases.
